assertions.title: Keyboard-first navigation remains viable across shell and drawers

steps.expected: A browser-visible shell entry point is reachable by keyboard with visible focus treatment
steps.observed: On /, the first Tab focused the visible 'Skip to content' link. The active element reported tag=A, text='SKIP TO CONTENT', class='skip-link', and the focus ring was captured in VAL-CROSS-004-focus-home.png.

steps.action: Open /projects and tab through the shared shell into the filter rail
steps.expected: Projects filters are keyboard reachable with visible focus styling
steps.observed: On /projects, repeated Tab navigation reached the filter rail. The focused element reported tag=BUTTON, text='ALL', aria-pressed='true', with class tokens including 'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-white/45', and the visible focused state was captured in VAL-CROSS-004-focus-projects.png.

steps.action: Use keyboard-only navigation on / to focus and activate a project link
steps.expected: A project link is reachable without pointer interaction and opens its case-study route from the keyboard
steps.observed: On /, keyboard traversal reached the featured case card link for 'United vs Delta ORD-LGA Pricing Simulator' with href='/projects/ord-lga-price-war'. Pressing Enter navigated to http://localhost:3501/projects/ord-lga-price-war, confirming keyboard activation of a project link.

steps.action: Open /projects/tesla-nacs and tab to the trust/provenance entry point, then activate it from the keyboard
steps.expected: The assigned case-study route exposes a visible trust/provenance entry point on default load that is keyboard reachable, shows visible focus treatment, and can be activated without pointer input
steps.observed: On /projects/tesla-nacs, keyboard traversal reached the visible trust entry button labeled 'Trust, provenance & current run'. The focused element reported tag=BUTTON, aria-expanded='true', and class tokens including 'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-amber-200'. The focused state was captured in VAL-CROSS-004-focus-drawer.png. Pressing Enter toggled the control from 'HIDE TRUST DETAILS' to 'OPEN TRUST DETAILS' and set aria-expanded='false' while hiding the controlled panel, confirming keyboard activation of the trust/provenance entry point.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during the rerun flow on /, /projects, /projects/ord-lga-price-war, or /projects/tesla-nacs

frictions.description: The /projects interactive snapshot exposed the filter rail but did not enumerate the project cards as interactive refs during this rerun, so keyboard project-link activation evidence was captured from the home page featured case card instead.
frictions.resolution: Validated keyboard project-link activation on / by tabbing to the featured ORD-LGA case card and pressing Enter to navigate to /projects/ord-lga-price-war.

summary: Retested 1 assertion. VAL-CROSS-004 passed on the current 3501 runtime: keyboard traversal remained viable across the global shell and /projects filters, a project link was activated from the keyboard, and the visible trust/provenance entry point on /projects/tesla-nacs was reachable with Tab, showed visible focus treatment, and toggled via Enter without pointer interaction.
